events.title: Protostars in space and time: JWST, ALMA and time domain studies of protostellar evolution
events.summary: Explore the protostellar phase of star formation, where mass assembles, disks form, and planet formation begins. This science lecture discusses complex, time-dependent flows of mass, momentum, and energy, focusing on feedback and connections between infall and accretion, using data from JWST, ALMA, Spitzer, and WISE.

evidence.description: Using imaging and IFU data of protostars from the IPA and HEFE large programs on JWST, and time domain data with Spitzer and WISE, I will discuss the complex, time dependent flows of mass, momentum, and energy within a few 1000 au.

events.title: Biomedical Engineering (BME 500) Seminar Series
events.summary: This seminar explores the "inflammation-on-a-chip" microphysiological system, a novel approach to studying immune responses. The research investigates cell-cell interactions, focusing on critical signaling between myeloid cells, neutrophils, and the vascular endothelium, offering insights into chronic inflammation and disease.

evidence.description: In this seminar, I will present our research investigating cell-cell interactions using our “inflammation-on-a-chip” microphysiological system with a focus on critical signaling between myeloid cells, neutrophils, and the vascular endothelium.
